description: Reopen a side chat from the message you started it on, instead of hunting for it. A thread icon appears under every message that has side chats, with a count when there are several. Click it to open a panel tab for that message, with one inner tab for each of its side chats. Rename a side chat by double-clicking its tab. Works with bb's bundled Side chat plugin, including side chats made before you install it, and needs bb 0.49 or later.
